text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking with Air Messiah 
down the junior high classroom hallway—
choice_data_list: There's a 100-yen coin on the ground...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Lost property... When it's cash, it seems 
quite difficult to identify the owner.

Air Messiah and I examined the 100-yen 
coin, but there were no notable features. 
Just a tiny scratch next to the '1', 
perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, based on where and how it was 
dropped, it seems possible to narrow it 
down to some extent.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
When you came to the classroom to call for 
me, Trainer, there wasn't anything dropped 
around here, was there?
choice_data_list: Yeah, you didn't drop at all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"If that's the case, the owner must be 
someone who just passed through here. 
Plus, since this is near the junior high 
classrooms..."
choice_data_list:
There's a high chance she's an Uma Musume 
enrolled in middle school.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let's go around the classrooms and 
ask if anyone knows anything.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I don't think it's mine. I forgot my 
wallet today, so...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I asked everyone in the classroom, but 
they said it's probably not it. I'm sorry 
I couldn't be of more help.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"No, that was plenty helpful. I'll go ask 
the other girls."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"We'll keep asking around too. I hope we 
find it soon!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What you dropped was just a 100-yen coin? 
Aw, I thought it was a secret key or 
something like that.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
B-But you can buy plenty of things with 
100 yen. Like candy, or gum...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, that's not what I'm talking about! 
You had such a serious look on your face, 
I thought something terrible happened! 
What a waste of worry!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for causing you such distress. 
Thank you for your cooperation. I'll try 
asking our seniors as well.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's not mine. Do you know whose it 
might be, Sei-chan?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's mine! I can't believe it came 
back to me! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I see. I'm so glad it was found 
safely, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah............ Sorry. That was a lie just 
now.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha~! I didn't mean anything bad by 
it! You two were just so into it, I 
couldn't resist teasing you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You've been asking around for quite a 
while, haven't you? You did your duty, so 
shouldn't it be fine to take it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: No, lost property is still lost property.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Once I finish asking around, I plan to 
drop it off in the academy's lost and 
found box along with a note explaining how 
I found it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, you really give it your all, don't 
you? Whether you're just too nice or 
overly serious...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~, come to think of it, I saw a girl 
looking for something outside! I think 
she's still around the tree-lined path~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"It's not here... It's not... It's not 
anywhere! No way, it's nowhere to be 
found... Uuuuugh..."

"When I visited the spot Seiun Sky told me 
about, Meisho Doto was on the verge of 
tears, peering all around the path."
choice_data_list:
Is this what you're looking for by any 
chance?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ah...!! M-May I see that, 
please...!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"The mint year matches, and that tiny 
scratch next to the 1... There's no doubt, 
this is the 100-yen coin I was looking 
for...! It's found... It's a miracle... 
Uuuu..."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I found this near the junior high 
classrooms. I'm so glad, it was an 
important 100 yen, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's my treasure! Opera O-san gave 
this to me, you see...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-Opera O-san...! I-I bought the throat 
lozenges you asked for. And here's your 
100 yen change...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly sorry, Doto! Thanks to you, I 
can head into the interview in top 
condition!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, keep the change. It's a small token of 
my appreciation—go buy yourself some 
sweets!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
With those words, she pressed this 100-yen 
coin into my hand... I could never bring 
myself to spend it...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very, very much for 
delivering this! I will never forget this 
kindness!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I only did what anyone would do. Please 
take care not to lose it again."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... That settles that matter. Thank 
you for your hard work, Trainer."
choice_data_list:
No. As expected of you, Messiah—you saw it 
through to the end.

Doing a good deed really puts you in a 
good mood.

Doing a good deed really makes you feel 
good, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... That settles that matter. Thank 
you for your hard work, Trainer."
choice_data_list:
No. As expected of you, Messiah—you saw it 
through to the end.

Doing a good deed really puts you in a 
good mood.

Doing a good deed really makes you feel 
good, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Right back at you. ...I truly am glad 
you're my Trainer. You face everything 
with the exact same feelings as me.
choice_data_list: Let's keep taking it step by step.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Steadily and diligently, true to who 
we are.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even if people laugh at me for being 
too serious, if there is someone out there 
who will be happy, it is well worth the 
effort.
choice_data_list: Let's take pride in being diligent.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. Both of us, holding our heads high.
